architecture.details:
NATIVE HUE ENGINE

Native file codec
implemented

Save literal RGBD with shape metadata and SHA-256. Load only after length, budget, checksum and color validation.

Inputs
Tensor or file path and byte budget
Outputs
HUECT file or new owned tensor
Side effects
Reads files. Writes a synced adjacent temporary file and renames it.
Ownership
Rust loader owns loaded buffers. Writer cleans temporary files on failure.
Direct call dependencies
No direct call edge in this reviewed map.
Trust boundary
Untrusted file bytes enter memory. SHA-256 checks corruption, not author identity.
Failure behavior
Oversize, malformed, trailing, corrupt or noncanonical files fail. Rename rules depend on the OS.

Research notes

Recorded conclusions, including negative results

01
periodic: hue8 minus numeric_circular8 mean paired angular_mae_radians difference 0 across 1 seeds. These controls share quantization levels, so color labels alone do not establish an advantage.
02
scalar: chroma8 minus int8 mean paired validation_loss difference 0 across 1 seeds. These controls share quantization levels, so color labels alone do not establish an advantage.
03
scalar: rgb24 minus fixed24 mean paired validation_loss difference 0 across 1 seeds. These controls share quantization levels, so color labels alone do not establish an advantage.
04
RGB24 is a fixed-point quantizer with color byte labels. RGBD32 preserves finite FP32 values by exposing sign, fraction, and exponent bytes. Neither removes binary arithmetic.
ChromaTensor uses bits and numerical computation. Color is the tensor encoding and inspection interface.

View recorded validation curves

independent random phase/amplitude low-rank periodic tensors. 2-epoch fixed chromatic input transform with chroma8 weight/activation MLP; all matrix products/optimizer FP32. held-out samples from the same structured generator; cannot reconstruct arbitrary erased data. The scalar and spectral inputs have equal 24-bit field budgets. Spectral amplitude-scale metadata and the erasure mask cost extra storage.

The cube supports integer-only layer rotations in three through six dimensions, with exact four-turn and inverse restoration of cell codes and identities.

The distributed field stores a phase8/magnitude16 full complex FFT. It uses floating point transforms and carries Hermitian redundancy. It is an implemented spectral representation, not a literal optical hologram.

Every numeric polar control uses exactly the same 24-bit quantization as its chromatic field. Their inputs, training curves, and reconstruction outputs are identical. Color naming supplies no reconstruction advantage.

At approximately 50% retained coordinates, mean held-out periodic-field MSE was 0.01821456 for direct RGB and 0.01882225 for the distributed field. These masks erase coordinates in different bases.

Partial field erasure loses information. The trained reconstruction models evaluate held-out low-rank periodic fields from the same generator and a separate random-noise negative control. Their results do not establish recovery of arbitrary data from fragments.
